page_title: BHA 0-0 WOL | Brighton v Wolves 22/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Toti (Wolves) is booked.
90+2' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood will be replaced by Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton).
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Neto departs the field of play to be replaced by Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves).
82' Adam Webster (Brighton) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
81' Mario Lemina (Wolves) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Jason Steele.
76' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
76' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Brighton win a corner.
73' Max Kilman (Wolves) picks up a yellow card.
73' Max Kilman (Wolves) makes a slide tackle, but referee Craig Pawson blows for a foul. Brighton will take a free kick.
73' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. James Milner is replaced by Adam Webster (Brighton).
72' A substitution has been made. Pervis Estupinan is replaced by Adam Lallana (Brighton).
70' It's time for a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) comes on in place of Pablo Sarabia.
68' Flag goes up against Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Facundo Buonanotte and he is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Danny Welbeck walks off the pitch to be replaced by Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
58' The foul by Lewis Dunk (Brighton) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will deliver the corner kick.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pervis Estupinan (Brighton). Brighton get a corner.

57' Craig Dawson (Wolves) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
56' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
56' Pedro Neto (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolves will take a corner.
54' Craig Dawson (Wolves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
54' The resulting corner from Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is cleared.
54' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
52' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
50' Jose Sa comes off his line to intercept the corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton).
49' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

46' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Jason Steele shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Joao Pedro (Brighton) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Jose Sa makes a save.
39' Brighton are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
37' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes a short corner kick.

36' James Milner (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
33' Flag up against Danny Welbeck (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

30' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) receives a reproachful look from Pedro Neto. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
28' The corner from Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is cleared away by the defence.
28' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.

26' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) latches on to a well-placed cross from the free kick on the edge of the box and attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick header towards the net. Unfortunately for him, the keeper was quicker and denies him. The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
25' Mario Lemina (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Craig Pawson blows his whistle for an infringement. Brighton have a free kick.

22' CLOSE! Pedro Neto (Wolves) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
19' The percentage of ball possession is – 71:29.
15' The linesman signals that Matt Doherty (Wolves) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
12' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away.
12' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
11' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. Brighton earn a corner.
9' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
8' Pedro Neto (Wolves) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Brighton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Craig Pawson will referee today's match.
